summary: Native one-shot agents register their exact live launch incarnation before their command can claim work, removing timing-dependent startup refusals

replay.detail: Existing runtime observations remain authoritative; no graph replay.

rules.detail: Work incarnation liveness remains running-only; unpublished and stale incarnations remain refused.

compatibility.detail: No public API change. Native launch completion now releases a held command only after its existing desired/start-operation fence commits running authority, exporting the exact ST3_INCARNATION and FRACTAL_INCARNATION. Ordinary observation reports held launches as starting, never bypassing registration. Inherited incarnation aliases are discarded.

downtime.detail: No service interruption; already-running commands are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Registration refusal or write failure cancels the unreleased command and retires its exact operation-owned runtime through the existing native cleanup path.
